description.value: Pure Vanilla is a beloved neighbourhood institution in Oak Bay's Estevan Village, baking entirely from scratch for nearly 25 years using organic ingredients wherever possible. The café serves expertly crafted espresso drinks, freshly baked pastries, and a rotating seasonal savory lunch menu that leans heavily on house-made breads and locally sourced produce. Cyclists can eat inside the cozy café or settle onto the sunny back patio.

address.value: 2590 Cadboro Bay Road, Unit 105, Oak Bay, BC

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 10m; rack (4 spaces) at 31m; rack (6 spaces) at 42m; rack (2 spaces) at 47m. Total: 12 spaces.
